callouts.title: System Overview
callouts.body: This guide provides comprehensive scaffolding for implementing an AI Agent Coordination System where [[Claude Code]] and [[Gemini Code Assist]] function as intelligent coding partners and PKB librarians. The system leverages a structured vault architecture to enable agents to self-coordinate, access domain knowledge, maintain session context, and execute complex multi-step workflows. This document reduces cognitive load by breaking implementation into digestible phases with clear operational procedures.

callouts.title: The Library Curator Framework
callouts.body: Think of your `.claude` folder as a **Library Reference Desk**. When an AI agent "arrives" (is invoked via Claude Code or Gemini), they first check in at the desk (read `CLAUDE.md`/`GEMINI.md`), receive their orientation packet (`SYSTEM_INIT.md`), review the library's organizational system (`00-meta`), and then can competently navigate the entire knowledge base to assist with your work. They're not just tools—they're **trained librarians** who understand your classification system.

callouts.title: File Creation Protocol
callouts.body: Each agent needs a dedicated entry point that loads immediately when invoked. These files serve as **constitutional instructions** that define the agent's role within your system.

callouts.title: Self-Coordination Principles
callouts.body:
1. **Context-First:** Always load session memory before beginning work
2. **Document-as-You-Go:** Update session memory with significant actions
3. **Ask-Before-Destructive:** Confirm before deleting/modifying core files
4. **Resource-Aware:** Reference `__LOCAL-REPO` resources when they exist rather than generating from scratch
5. **Handoff-Ready:** Document work in progress for seamless Gemini handoffs

callouts.title: Self-Agent Coordinator
callouts.body: **Self-Agent Coordinator:** An AI agent operating mode where the agent autonomously manages context loading, session continuity, resource discovery, and task execution within a structured Personal Knowledge Base. The agent acts as both executor and orchestrator, intelligently navigating vault resources without requiring step-by-step user instruction.

callouts.title: Reducing Agent Confusion
callouts.body:
The system's complexity is managed through **layered context loading**:

1. **Entry Point** (Agent Init) = Role & Permissions
2. **System Init** (this file) = Constitutional Rules
3. **Session Memory** = Current State
4. **Project Docs** = Task-Specific Context

Agents load contexts **just-in-time**, preventing information overload while ensuring necessary context availability.

callouts.title: Critical Metadata Infrastructure
callouts.body: These files enable session continuity and context persistence. They're the "working memory" of your agent system.

callouts.title: Constitutional Document
callouts.body: This file defines vault-wide metadata standards. Changes require explicit user approval as they affect system-wide consistency.

callouts.title: Your First Coordinated Session
callouts.body: Now that infrastructure exists, you'll experience the agent coordination system in action. This phase builds confidence through successful execution.

callouts.title: What If It Doesn't Work?
callouts.body:
If Claude doesn't automatically read the files:
1. Explicitly provide the path: "Read D:\10_pur3v4d3r's-vault\.claude\CLAUDE.md"
2. Check file permissions (Windows may block access)
3. Verify paths match exactly (Windows uses backslashes)
4. Consider creating a `.claudeignore` file if certain folders should be excluded

callouts.title: Working Session Templates
callouts.body: These templates standardize your interactions with agents, reducing cognitive load by providing clear structures for common workflows.

callouts.title: The Central Paradox
callouts.body: This system reduces long-term cognitive load by investing upfront effort in structure. You're teaching agents to self-coordinate so you don't have to micromanage every interaction. The initial learning curve is steep, but the payoff is substantial.

callouts.title: Expansion Pathways
callouts.body: Once core system is operational, explore these advanced capabilities:

callouts.title: Final Thoughts
callouts.body: **"The goal is not to remember the system, but to trust it."** You're building infrastructure that reduces the cognitive burden of working with AI partners. The initial investment in structure pays continuous dividends as agents become reliable co-workers who maintain their own context, discover their own resources, and coordinate their own workflows. Your role shifts from micromanager to strategic director. Start small. Test thoroughly. Expand gradually. Trust the process.
